records.name: Sleep Calculator
records.tagline: Wake up refreshed using REM sleep cycle science

records.name: WriteFlow: Focused Writing App
records.tagline: WriteFlow is the distraction-free, offline-first workspace.
records.description: Every writing app I tried was either bloated with features I didn't need, constantly nudging me to sign up for cloud sync, or so minimal it offered no accountability whatsoever. I'd open Google Docs, get a notification, check Twitter, and suddenly an hour was gone. Sound familiar? So I built the app I actually wanted to use. WriteFlow is a distraction-free writing app for Android — built around one idea: your writing habit deserves the same discipline as your fitness habit.

records.name: Cloudback for Linear
records.tagline: Automated backup and restore for Linear workspaces
records.description: Cloudback runs automated, snapshot-based backups for Linear workspaces, GitHub, GitLab, and Azure DevOps. Linear capture covers 23 data categories: issues, projects, cycles, documents, comments, attachments, embedded files, and the workspace structure itself. Restore in dependency order from any backup, into a new target workspace. AES-256 with optional customer-managed keys (RSA Lockbox). SOC 2 Type II compliant. 1.7k+ customers, 14k+ repositories, 4M+ backups.

records.name: Permute 4.0
records.tagline: The ultimate media converter for macOS
records.description: Permute is a quick image, audio, and video converter. You can use it for files of all formats because Permute can convert anything into anything (almost). For water to water-to-wine conversion, you’d have to refer to other authorities, but media files can become whatever format you need them to. records.name: HypeComic Bot — 30 Day Trial

records.description: Memoriq is your private AI memory for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok. Save the conversations that matter in an end-to-end encrypted vault that only you can access.
